title: CALL FORTH DIVINE HELPERS TO LOCATE YOU THIS WEEK
text: Beloved, I want you to take a moment and share this prayer with someone, there is a prophetic grace upon this word. And the Lord showed me that as you share it, you are releasing a divine signal into the atmosphere that will attract the helpers of your destiny. Share it with your family. Share it with friends. Share it on your social media platforms. Don't just keep it to yourself. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 11:1, "Cast thy bread upon the waters, for thou shalt find it after many days." When you share what God is doing, you are sewing a seed that will bring forth a harvest of divine connections. So, pause right now, share this ministration, and watch how God will begin to orchestrate meetings, encounters, and alignments that will shock you. Now, let us go into the presence of the Lord. I want to speak to you tonight about a dimension of divine intervention that many believers have not fully accessed. The scripture is replete with examples of how God strategically positioned certain individuals in the path of his servants to facilitate the fulfillment of their assignments. When we look at the life of David, we see that before he ever sat on the throne, God sent Jonathan to him. Jonathan was a divine helper. He was the son of the very man who was trying to kill David. Yet God turned the heart of Jonathan toward David. And through that connection, David's life was preserved multiple times. When you study the book of Esther, you discover that Modi was strategically positioned as a divine helper. God placed him at the king's gate at such a time as that and through him an entire nation was saved from anhilation. You see, there is a principle in the kingdom that many people have not understood. God does not just give you a promise. He gives you people who will help you carry the weight of that promise. He gives you people who will open doors that your own hands cannot open. He gives you people who will speak on your behalf in rooms you have not yet entered. And tonight I am releasing a prophetic decree that every divine helper that God has assigned to your life, every person that carries a key to your next level, every individual that has been ordained from the foundations of the earth to intersect with your path, they will locate you this week. They will find you. They will come into alignment with your destiny. And you will know that surely the Lord has visited you. The Bible says in Genesis chapter 24 that Abraham sent his servant to go and find a wife for Isaac. Now Abraham's servant did something very instructional. He prayed a specific prayer. He said, "Oh Lord, God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day and show kindness unto my master Abraham." He asked God for success in his mission that very day. He didn't pray a general prayer. He didn't say, "Lord, whenever you're ready, wherever you want." He said, "This day, show me the woman." And before he had finished speaking, the Bible says Rebecca came out. That is the kind of speed and precision that God wants to demonstrate in your life this week. Some of you have been waiting for years. You have been praying. You have been fasting. You have been believing God. But it seems like the right connections are not coming. It seems like the people who should see your value don't see it. It seems like those who should recommend you are silent. But I prophesy to you by the spirit of the living God. Your time of obscurity is over. Your season of being overlooked has expired. This week, divine helpers will begin to locate you. They will come from the north, from the south, from the east, and from the west. Some will come through a phone call you were not expecting. Some will come through an email that will arrive in your inbox. Some will come through a casual conversation that will turn into a life-changing relationship. God is about to shock you with the caliber of people he's bringing into your life. Now, let me show you something in the scriptures that will build your faith. In 2 Kings chapter 4, there was a wealthy woman in Shunim who was a divine helper to Elisha. The Bible says she constrained him to eat bread. She insisted that every time he passed through that region, he must come to her house and eat. She wasn't looking for anything from Elisha initially. She was simply flowing in her assignment as a helper of destiny. She convinced her husband to build a room for the prophet, a bed, a table, a stool, and a candlestick. She created an atmosphere where the anointing could rest. And one day, Elisha asks, "What can I do for this woman?" His servant Gahazi said, "Well, she has no child and her husband is old." And Elisha prophesied about this time next year, you shall embrace a son. What am I saying to you? The helpers that God is sending to you this week are not just people who will take from you. Some of them will be so blessed by your presence, by your anointing, by the grace upon your life that they will turn around and ask, "What can I do for you?" They will look for ways to bless you. They will look for opportunities to promote you. They will lie awake at night thinking about how to facilitate your breakthrough. That is the kind of divine helpers God is releasing into your life this week. And you will not miss them in the name of Jesus. Let me take you to the book of Exodus. When Moses was born, Pharaoh had decreed that every male child born to the Hebrews must be killed. But God had already positioned divine helpers. First, there were the Hebrew midwives, Shiffra and Pora, who refused to obey Pharaoh's command. They feared God more than they feared the king. And because of their obedience, male children were preserved. Then there was Moses's mother, Joabed, who hid him for 3 months. When she could no longer hide him, she put him in an ark and placed him by the river. But here is where it gets interesting. God positioned Pharaoh's daughter to come to that exact spot at that exact time. The Bible says she had compassion on the baby. She was a divine helper. She was the daughter of the very man who wanted Moses dead. Yet God turned her heart and she adopted Moses and raised him in Pharaoh's palace. Do you see the pattern? God will use the most unlikely people to be your helpers. He will use people who by natural calculation should be your enemies. He will use people who don't even share your faith, who don't go to your church, who don't speak your language. But because God has ordained them to be part of your story, they will show you favor that defies logic. They will protect you when others want to destroy you. They will promote you when others want to demote you. And I declare over your life tonight, every Pharaoh's daughter that God has assigned to you, every person of influence who has been ordained to show you unexpected favor, they will locate you this week in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, I want to shift into prayer. But before I do, let me give you one more scriptural foundation. In the book of Acts chapter 16, Paul and Silas had just been beaten and thrown into prison. Their backs were bleeding, their feet were in stalks, and they were in the innermost part of the prison. But at midnight, they began to pray and sing praises to God. And the Bible says, "Suddenly, there was a great earthquake, and the foundations of the prison were shaken, and immediately all the doors were opened and everyone's chains were loosed." But notice what happened next. The jailer woke up, saw the doors open, and was about to kill himself because he thought all the prisoners had escaped. But Paul cried out, "Do thyself no harm, for we are all here." That night, the jailer became a divine helper. The same man who had thrust them into the inner prison, who had fastened their feet in the stalks, became the man who washed their wombs and brought them into his house and set food before them. He and his entire household were baptized that same night. What am I saying? The same situations that the enemy meant to destroy you will produce your divine helpers. The same environments where you have suffered will become the places where you meet the people God has assigned to bless you. Even now as you are reading this prayer, God is converting your adversaries into advocates. He's turning your pharaohs into fathers. He is transforming your opponents into opportunists who will work in your favor. Let us pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace with boldness, knowing that you are a covenant keeping God. Your word says in Psalm 84-11, "No good thing will you withhold from them that walk uprightly." Lord, I stand on that promise tonight. On behalf of every person reading this prayer, I decree that every good thing that you have reserved for them, every divine helper that you have prepared for them, every door of opportunity that you have set before them, none of it shall be withheld any longer. Father, your word declares in Isaiah 6:1, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. I prophesy that the light of divine favor is rising upon every life connected to this prayer. As that light rises, it will attract the right people. It will draw divine helpers like a magnet draws ion. Lord, cause these individuals to become suddenly visible to those who have the capacity to bless them, to promote them, to elevate them, and to facilitate their destinies. In the name of Jesus, I decree the release of Revelation 3:8. Behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it. Every door that needs to open this week for divine connections to be made, I command them to swing wide open now. Every door that has been shut by delay, by opposition, by spiritual resistance, Father, let your hand push those doors open. Let divine helpers walk through those doors into the lives of your children. Let appointments be ordained that were not on any calendar. Let meetings be arranged that were not scheduled by human wisdom. Lord, I pray for supernatural speed. Your word says in Isaiah 60-22, I the Lord will hasten it in his time. Father, hasten the location of divine helpers. Accelerate their coming. What was supposed to take months, let it happen in days. What was supposed to take years, let it happen in weeks. release angelic acceleration over this word. Dispatch your angels to go and bring these helpers from wherever they are. Some are in other cities, some are in other nations, some are in other continents. Father, let there be a divine orchestration that brings them into alignment with your children this week. I come against every spirit of isolation in the name of Jesus. I come against every demonic agenda to keep believers disconnected from their divine helpers. The enemy knows that when the right people connect with the right people, kingdoms are established. The enemy knows that when Jonathan finds David, Saul's agenda is frustrated. So, Satan has worked over time to keep divine helpers and destiny career separated. But tonight, I break every satanic conspiracy of isolation. I break every cycle of loneliness. I break every pattern of rejection that has kept people at a distance. I decree that the barriers are coming down, the walls are falling, and divine connections are being established now in the name of Jesus Christ. Father, I pray specifically for those who have been sabotaged by their own helpers. People who were supposed to be bridges but became barriers. People who were supposed to be doors but became walls. Lord, your word says in Romans 8:28 that all things work together for good to them that love you. I decree that even the betrayal they experience was working to position them for greater helpers. Even the disappointment was working to prepare them for divine appointments. Let every setback become a setup for a major comeback. Let every person who walked away make room for the people you are sending who will never leave. I speak to the spirit of discernment. Holy Spirit, give these believers the ability to recognize their divine helpers when they show up. Let them not be so wounded from past relationships that they push away the people you are sending. Give them wisdom to know who is sent from heaven and who is sent from hell. Give them discernment to distinguish between a divine helper and a demonic hindrance. Let them not reject their Jonathan because they are still healing from their soul. Let them not push away their esther because they are still bitter about their vashi. Give them clarity of vision to see what you are doing. Oh God, Lord, I pray for divine helpers who are business people. I call them forth now. Let entrepreneurs, investors, and business owners who carry the Zebulon anointing, those who know how to create wealth and who understand kingdom economics, let them locate believers this week. Let them see proposals that would have been ignored. Let them approve loans that would have been denied. Let them sign contracts that would have been rejected. Let them release funding that would have been withheld. Father, connect your children with people who have financial capacity and a kingdom heart. people who will not just bless them but will partner with them to establish businesses to launch ventures to fund projects that will advance your kingdom. I call for divine helpers who are gatekeepers. I speak to every person who sits at the gate of opportunity. Every person who has the authority to say yes or no. Every person who controls access to resources, to platforms, to networks, to institutions. Father, let these gatekeepers receive a divine download about the people you are sending to them. Let them have dreams. Let them have visions. Let them have an unexplainable conviction that they must help these individuals. Let them experience what Pharaoh's daughter experienced when she saw Moses. Let compassion rise up in them. Let favor be activated in them. Let a supernatural inclination toward blessing be ignited in them. I call for divine helpers who are counselors and advisors. Let people with wisdom, with insight, with experience, with knowledge locate believers this week. Let mentors appear who will take them under their wing. Let coaches emerge who will train them for their next level. Let advisors manifest who will give them strategies that will save them years of trial and error. Father, your word says in Proverbs 11:14, "In the multitude of counselors there is safety. I decree the multiplication of wise counselors around your children this week. Let them suddenly have access to people whose advice is worth millions, whose insight can shift trajectories, whose wisdom can prevent disasters. I call forth divine helpers who are intercessors. Let prayer warriors who carry the burden of intercession be connected with those who need prayer covering. Let people who know how to birth things in the spirit be assigned to destinies that are about to be delivered. Father, surround your children with an army of intercessors who will stand in the gap for them who will fight battles in the spirit on their behalf. who will pray them through seasons of warfare and into seasons of victory. Let these intercessors locate them this week and let there be a supernatural synergy in the spirit that will produce breakthrough after breakthrough. I speak to every Boaz, locate your roots this week. I speak to every Naomi, find your roots this week. I speak to every Elijah, discover your Elisha this week. I speak to every Paul connect with your Timothy this week. Father, let the generations come together. Let the season meet the emerging. Let the experience embrace the enthusiastic. Let the old pour into the young and let the young refresh the old. Release divine connections across generational lines that will produce powerful kingdom impact. Lord, I pray for divine helpers who operate in the marketplace. Let them be seven mountain influencers who understand that kingdom dominion is not just in the church but in every sphere of society. Connect your children with people who have influence in government, in education, in media, in entertainment, in business, in family, and in religion. Let these influencers become bridges that will help believers step into their assignments in every mountain of culture. Let this week be marked by unprecedented access to spheres of influence that have previously been closed. Father, I come against the spirit of pride that will make someone miss their divine helper because the helper didn't look like what they expected. I come against the spirit of prejudice that would cause someone to reject a helper because of their race, their denomination, their social status, or their background. Humble the hearts of your children, oh God. Let them receive help from wherever you choose to send it. Let them not despise small beginnings or humble packages. Let them recognize that you can send a divine helper in the form of a child, in the form of a poor person, in the form of someone they would naturally overlook. Open their eyes to see beyond the natural and perceive the divine assignment on people's lives. I decree that every divine helper is being awakened right now. Even as this prayer is being prayed, there are people who don't even know why, but they are thinking about someone. They are being stirred in their spirit to make a phone call, to send a message, to reach out, to connect. Lord, I thank you that you are orchestrating these thoughts. You are directing these impulses. You are orchestrating these divine inclinations. Let every divine helper feel an urgency to act this week. Let them not procrastinate. Let them not postpone. Let them obey the voice of your spirit immediately. Father, I pray for protection over these divine connections. Once the helpers locate the people you've assigned them to help, let the enemy not be able to sow discord, to create misunderstanding, to generate offense, or to sabotage the relationship. Let these connections be sealed in the spirit. Let them be covenantally bound. Let them be protected by angelic hosts. Let no weapon formed against these relationships prosper. Let every tongue that rises in judgment against these partnerships be condemned. Let gossip fail. Let slander bounce back. Let jealousy be frustrated. Let every attempt of the enemy to separate divine helpers from destiny carriers be overthrown in the name of Jesus. I declare that this week will be remembered as the week of divine location. This will be the week when things changed. This will be the week when the right door opened. This will be the week when the right person called. This will be the week when the right opportunity presented itself. This will be the week when God showed himself strong on behalf of his children. Mark it. Write it down. Prophesy it. This is your week of divine helpers. Lord, I pray specifically for those who have been betrayed in the past and who are afraid to trust again. Heal their hearts. restore their ability to receive. Let them know that not everyone is like the person who hurts them. Let them know that you have faithful people, loyal people, committed people who are waiting to be assigned to them. Let their past pain not block their future gain. Let their yesterday's disappointment not prevent tomorrow's appointment. do a healing work in their emotions, in their souls, in their ability to trust so that when the right helper comes, they will not push them away out of fear. I speak to women who need divine helpers for marriage. I decree that every God orained husband who is supposed to locate you will find you this week. Let the right men have their eyes opened to see the virtuous woman that you are. Let them recognize your value. Let them perceive your worth. Let them understand that you are a gift from God. And let every wrong man, every counterfeit, every distraction lose interest and move along. Let there be a divine separation between the genuine and the fake. Let the real stand out and let the false fade away. I speak to men who need divine helpers for business and career. Let employers see your resume this week. Let hiring managers be impressed by your qualifications. Let business partners recognize the value you bring. Let clients seek you out. Let contracts be awarded to you. Let tenders be worn by you. Let proposals be accepted. Let presentations be compelling. Let your voice be heard in rooms of decision. Let your name come up in conversations of opportunity. Let people recommend you who don't even know you personally but who have heard about your work, your integrity, your excellence. Father, I pray for students who need divine helpers for scholarships, admissions, and academic advancement. Let professors notice them. Let scholarship committees be moved by their applications. Let admission officers approve their entrance into programs that seemed impossible. Let doors open in universities, in colleges, in institutions of learning. Let financial aid be released. Let grants be awarded. Let free education be provided. where it seemed like there was no way to pay for school. Do it supernaturally. Lord, do it in ways that cannot be explained except by your hand. I speak to those in ministry who need divine helpers for the expansion of the gospel. Let wealthy believers with a heart for missions locate you this week. Let people with resources for kingdom work find your ministry. Let media professionals who can help you reach more people discover your message. Let technology experts who can build your platforms connect with you. Let administrators who can organize your growth join your team. Let intercessors who will hold up your hands like Aaron and her held up Moses's hands be assigned to you. Father, accelerate the spread of the gospel through divine connections made this week. Lord, I thank you that you are not a man that you should lie, neither the son of man that you should repent. What you have spoken concerning divine helpers shall surely come to pass. Every word released in this prayer is established in the heavens and shall be manifested on the earth. I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover every participant with the blood of Jesus. I release the fire of the Holy Ghost to consume every opposition to this word. And I decree that it is done. It is finished. It is settled in the mighty, powerful, matchless, glorious name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Now, lift your voice wherever you are and begin to thank God for what he's about to do. Thank him for the divine helpers that are on the way. Thank him for the connections that are being orchestrated. Thank him for the doors that are about to open. Thank him for the favor that is about to locate you. Don't wait until you see it. Thank him now by faith. Let your praise be prophetic. Let your thanksgiving be a declaration that what God has said is already done. Shout unto God with a voice of triumph. Give him praise. Give him glory. Give him honor. For he alone is worthy. He alone is faithful. He alone is true. And what he has promised, he's able also to perform. Amen. Amen.
